IMPLEMENTED.meaning: The computation is wired, persistent, tested and approved in the Cy Soma specification.

PROVISIONAL.meaning: Working plumbing or an older heuristic exists, but it is not an approved grounded model.

soma_variables.status_note: The displayed anxiety value is still produced by the older heuristic experienced-state model. A separate grounded probabilistic threat-prediction dependency is LIVE, but no approved mapping converts it into anxiety.
Currently produced by the older heuristic experienced-state model. No grounded stress-load specification has been approved.
Injury and discomfort plumbing exists, but the current magnitude and recovery rules are unapproved heuristics.

A grounded feeding and ingestion ledger is LIVE separately. The displayed Hunger value still comes from the older arbitrary baseline, elapsed-time curve, meal effects and deprivation impulses; no approved model converts feeding history into subjective hunger.
Grounded Process S and schedule-estimated Process C are implemented separately. No approved mapping combines them into subjective fatigue; this existing fatigue index remains an unapproved heuristic.
Richer social-event distinctions exist, but their conversion into a social-need value is an unapproved heuristic.
Currently produced by older event and relationship heuristics. No grounded anger/appraisal specification has been approved.
The current unresolved-event and repeated-output mechanism is an unapproved heuristic.

soma_subsystems.status_note: A parameter-free Beta-Bernoulli learner updates separate structured cue and adverse-outcome associations from resolved environment trials. It predicts outcomes; it is not anxiety, fear intensity, arousal, or brain activation.
The live learner assumes stationary cue-outcome contingencies. No volatility, reversal, forgetting, or dynamic learning-rate model is implemented.
No similarity, cue generalisation, latent-context inference, or context-switching model is implemented.
The learner updates explicitly identified cue and outcome pairs independently. No latent-context or contextual-inference model is implemented.

An event-driven vector keeps present external cues, separate learned cue-outcome posteriors, categorical imminence, world ambiguity, objective control and outcome resolution inspectable without producing a threat or anxiety score.
Reports only the categorical control affordance explicitly supplied by the structured world: none, limited, substantial or unknown. It is not perceived control.
No grounded model estimates Cy's subjective belief about control.
No instrumental action-outcome controllability learner is implemented.

A categorical engineering ontology records potential, imminent, ongoing, resolved or unknown temporal status from structured facts. It is informed by threat-imminence theory but is not a numeric biological scale.
Only externally present structured cues can open a current defensive context. Psychological reactivation by memory or imagination is not modelled.

Canonical structured records distinguish scheduled expectation, food offering, availability, receipt, full or partial consumption, refusal, unavailability and unknown intake without converting them to Hunger.
Persists complete post-installation objective meal and intake records, last known intake, exact observed portions and explicit unknowns.
Tracks scheduled food unavailability, refusals and unknown intake separately, including explicit runner-observation gaps. It contains no deprivation magnitude.
No calibrated internal physiological state H, preferred state H*, depletion dynamics or food-to-physiology outcome K exists for Cy.
No gastric, intestinal or gut-hormone model exists.
No sensory, reward-value or hedonic feeding model exists.
The prison meal schedule is an environmental expectation only; no anticipatory appetite model exists.
The grounded ledger does not select food-seeking, eating or refusal actions.
Cy's metabolic expenditure, body mass, digestion, meal-equivalent energy and gastric dynamics are not calibrated or assumed.
Normalized Process S integrates actual observed sleep and wake intervals using the published Two-Process exponential formulation. It is not a measure of subjective fatigue.
Published five-harmonic Process C waveform. Biological phase is not observed; a circular phase interval is estimated from the configured habitual wake schedule and shown with uncertainty.
No light/zeitgeber phase-response model or free-running phase drift is implemented. Process C is treated as stably entrained to the configured prison schedule.

brain_regions.status_note: The mammalian SCN is the principal circadian pacemaker. This specific display represents Cy's modelled Process C phase and output; it is not simulated neuronal firing, activation, or biological measurement.

Grounded threat prediction and current external defensive-context subsystems are LIVE, but no approved mapping turns them into amygdala firing or activation. The older displayed mapping remains an unapproved linear heuristic and is not shown as live activation.
No BNST activation model or supported artwork mapping exists. Current ambiguity and temporal status are possible future dependencies only.
No PAG activation or defensive-response model exists. Categorical imminence is a possible future dependency only.
Objective control is represented, but perceived and learned controllability are not modelled; no vmPFC activation mapping is valid.

Intended to represent interoceptive processing. Feeding input history is now available as a future dependency, but no internal physiological or gut state is modelled. The displayed runner mapping is an unapproved linear heuristic and is not shown as live activation.

Structured feeding inputs are LIVE, but internal energy state, AgRP/NPY and POMC systems, peripheral signals and hypothalamic activity are NOT MODELLED. Elapsed time since intake does not illuminate this region.

The live threat learner provides expected outcome, uncertainty, and outcome surprisal as possible future dependencies, but no approved anterior-cingulate mapping exists. The older displayed mapping remains an unapproved linear heuristic and is not shown as live activation.
Intended to represent active contextual and episodic-memory computation. The displayed runner mapping is an unapproved linear heuristic and is not shown as live activation.

Intended to represent regulation and action-control processes. Objective control is now represented separately, but perceived and learned controllability remain unmodelled. The displayed runner mapping is an unapproved inverse linear heuristic and is not shown as live activation.
Intended to represent social-processing activity if later justified. The displayed runner mapping simply mirrors the provisional loneliness value.
